name: amphetamine
title: Amphetamine
description: Control Amphetamine sessions and keep-awake preferences from Raycast
author: nmindz

commands.name: session_status
commands.title: Session Status
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Show the current Amphetamine session and start, end, or toggle it

commands.name: start_session
commands.title: Start Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Start a session with a custom duration and display-sleep option

commands.name: quick_caffeinate
commands.title: Start Quick Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Start a session using the configured quick-session duration

commands.name: toggle_session
commands.title: Toggle Session
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Start the quick session when idle, or end the active session

commands.name: preferences_settings
commands.title: Manage Preferences
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Toggle display sleep, screen saver, closed-display mode, Triggers, and Drive Alive

commands.name: menu_bar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Amphetamine
commands.description: Show session status in the menu bar with quick actions

preferences.name: quickDuration
preferences.title: Quick Session Duration
preferences.description: Duration used by Start Quick Session, Toggle Session, the Session Status toggle, and the menu bar quick action

preferences.name: defaultDisplaySleep
preferences.title: Display Sleep
preferences.label: Allow the display to sleep during quick sessions
preferences.description: When enabled, quick and toggle sessions permit the display to sleep

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `pnpm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
